changes.before: The study used 24 volunteers in a fictional library to fill out both versions of an online booking form for 4 weeks.
changes.after: The study used 24 volunteers in a fictional library pilot to compare two versions of an online booking form for 4 weeks.
changes.reason: Restores the pilot context and avoids asserting that every volunteer filled out both versions, which the original does not specify.
The original reports a median, not a mean.

changes.before: Three volunteers failed to select the accessibility options option on the shorter form.
changes.after: Three volunteers missed the accessibility-options field in the shorter form.
changes.reason: Missing a field is not equivalent to failing to select an option; the original reports the former.
